Class OpponentReader.Window

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.rl.OpponentReader.Window
Enclosing class:
OpponentReader
public static final class OpponentReader.Window extends Object
The window one fighter keeps of its fight, a sample every OpponentReader.STRIDE ticks, oldest first. Per sample: the distance to the opponent (an eighth of the blocks, the last one known while it is out of sight), whether it is in sight, how fast it is moving away and up, its sword's charge and the fighter's own, a hit landed and a hit taken in the sample (kept, not averaged away), how fast the opponent was moving away four ticks after the fighter's last hit landed (held until the next one: near nothing only against an opponent that takes no knockback, which shows on the first hit), and how long the fight has been going (up to the window's length). Started afresh with every fight.
